entries.title: Job 9:1
segments: ¶And Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 9:2
segments: Of a truth I know it is so; but how can man be just with *God?

entries.title: Job 9:3
segments: If he shall choose to strive with him, he cannot answer him one thing of a thousand.

entries.title: Job 9:4
segments: He is wise in heart and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and had peace?

entries.title: Job 9:5
segments: Who removeth mountains, and they know it not, when he overturneth them in his anger;

entries.title: Job 9:6
segments: Who shaketh the earth out of its place, and the pillars thereof tremble;

entries.title: Job 9:7
segments: Who commandeth the sun, and it riseth not, and he sealeth up the stars;

entries.title: Job 9:8
segments: Who alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the high waves of the sea;

entries.title: Job 9:9
segments: Who maketh the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the chambers of the south;

entries.title: Job 9:10
segments: Who doeth great things past finding out, and wonders without number.

entries.title: Job 9:11
segments: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see [him] not; and he passeth along, and I perceive him not.

entries.title: Job 9:12
segments: Behold, he taketh away: who will hinder him? Who will say unto him, What doest thou?

entries.title: Job 9:13
segments: +God withdraweth not his anger; the proud helpers stoop under him:

entries.title: Job 9:14
segments: ¶How much less shall I answer him, choose out my words [to strive] with him?

entries.title: Job 9:15
segments: Whom, though I were righteous, [yet] would I not answer; I would make supplication to my judge.

entries.title: Job 9:16
segments: If I had called, and he had answered me, I would not believe that he hearkened to my voice, --

entries.title: Job 9:17
segments: He, who crusheth me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.

entries.title: Job 9:18
segments: He suffereth me not to take my breath, for he filleth me with bitternesses.

entries.title: Job 9:19
segments: Be it a question of strength, lo, [he is] strong; and be it of judgment, who will set me a time?

entries.title: Job 9:20
segments: If I justified myself, mine own mouth would condemn me; were I perfect, he would prove me perverse.

entries.title: Job 9:21
segments: Were I perfect, [yet] would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.

entries.title: Job 9:22
segments: ¶It is all one; therefore I said, he destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.

entries.title: Job 9:23
segments: If the scourge kill suddenly, he mocketh at the trial of the innocent.

entries.title: Job 9:24
segments: The earth is given over into the hand of the wicked [man]; he covereth the faces of its judges. If not, who then is it?

entries.title: Job 9:25
segments: ¶And my days are swifter than a runner: they flee away, they see no good.

entries.title: Job 9:26
segments: They pass by like skiffs of reed; as an eagle that swoops upon the prey.

entries.title: Job 9:27
segments: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my [sad] countenance, and brighten up,

entries.title: Job 9:28
segments: I am afraid of all my sorrows; I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.

entries.title: Job 9:29
segments: Be it that I am wicked, why then do I labour in vain?

entries.title: Job 9:30
segments: If I washed myself with snow-water, and cleansed my hands in purity,

entries.title: Job 9:31
segments: Then wouldest thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes would abhor me.

entries.title: Job 9:32
segments: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him; that we should come together in judgment.

entries.title: Job 9:33
segments: There is not an umpire between us, who should lay his hand upon us both.

entries.title: Job 9:34
segments: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his terror make me afraid,

entries.title: Job 9:35
segments: [Then] I will speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.
